items.title: The Catalan Twelve: Twelve Recipes, Recovered
items.author: Donnie Boman
items.description:
No one can prove the Catalan Twelve exist. That has never stopped them from taking credit, or avoiding it, for centuries. The same dough technique, the same insistence on cold butter, keeps turning up in kitchens that have no business knowing each other. Twelve real, fully tested recipes, from Girona xuxos to the Moon Pie, come with recovered ledger fragments and a reading list that isn't lying to you about everything. Underneath the conspiracy is a quieter story: one baker from the Gulf Coast, insisting that the place mattered. Believe the rest if you like.

It is, at once, a cookbook, a fake archival investigation, a comedy about provenance, and a memoir about inheritance, loss, and the fragile ways practical knowledge moves from one person to another. It understands that names drift, traditions are often invented after the fact, and recipes outlive their authors by belonging to whoever makes them next.

items.title: Consider the Fork
items.subtitle: A History of How We Cook and Eat
items.author: Bee Wilson
items.description: A history of kitchen technique itself, useful context for understanding how the same tools and methods really do travel and converge across unconnected places, without needing a Society to explain it.

items.title: The Cooking Gene
items.subtitle: A Journey Through African American Culinary History in the Old South
items.author: Michael Twitty
items.description: For the parts of The Catalan Twelve that transcended even the Society, or whomever.

items.title: BraveTart
items.subtitle: Iconic American Desserts
items.author: Stella Parks
items.description: A history of American desserts that takes apart their origin stories, usually in favor of something messier and better documented.

items.title: On Food and Cooking
items.subtitle: The Science and Lore of the Kitchen
items.author: Harold McGee
items.description: For anyone who wants the actual chemistry behind why cold fat laminates, why gelatin sets, and why browned butter smells the way it does, this is the reference The Catalan Twelve is quietly leaning on.
